approved_by.name: Pascal Charbonneau
approved_by.approval_record: Repository-owner request in the BlazeX Codex task to implement the next BH-02 phase section by section with one commit per section, one pull request, merge, synchronized-main cleanup, and feature-branch deletion.

authorized_scope: Activate only experiments/native_renderer_spike over the existing neutral Phase 5 renderer and Phase 2 through 4 semantic contracts.
Implement a bounded platform-neutral native-control batch and deterministic line protocol for the representative semantic slice.
Implement direct Win32, AppKit, and GTK 4 experiment adapters without a cross-platform widget toolkit.
Compile and execute the direct GTK 4 adapter in the available Linux/Xvfb environment, including actual controls, events, focus, selection, accessibility roles, stale rejection, and disposal.
Retain Windows and macOS compilation, execution, UI Automation, NSAccessibility, and manual assistive-technology work as explicit deferred qualification.
Publish headless, DOM, and native-spike comparison fixtures and Phase 7 evidence.
not_authorized: BH-02 Phase 8 or any later milestone
promotion of experiment code into a production package or executable profile
stable or public renderer, native batch, line protocol, host adapter, test, or component APIs
Qt or wxWidgets directly, transitively, as a fallback, or as a benchmark candidate
custom-scene rendering, WebView substitution, production desktop hosting, packaging, signing, or distribution
cross-platform geometry, pixel or visual equivalence, performance qualification, or broad component-family coverage
claims that deferred Windows, macOS, UI Automation, NSAccessibility, AT-SPI, screen-reader, or manual accessibility work passed
native-host, native-control, accessibility-conformance, security, performance, release, or support claims
